input.quote: 2.2 Vendor will be Customer's sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services throughout the term.
input.rationale: Section 2.2 imposes full-term exclusive dealing on Customer (Vendor as sole and exclusive provider of hosted analytics services) with no category limit, no time limit, and no performance-based exit — the playbook walk-away position. It also contradicts Section 2.1 (no minimum quantity or purchase commitment) and Section 12.3 (Vendor acknowledges Customer has made no exclusivity commitment and is free to engage any supplier). The exclusivity runs against us, not in our favour, so deletion is the minimal edit to reach the preferred position; a category-limited 12-month exclusivity with automatic termination on service-level or delivery failure is the fallback.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have deleted the sole-and-exclusive-provider commitment in Section 2.2, as our playbook does not permit exclusivity or sole-supplier obligations on the Customer, and this clause conflicts with Sections 2.1 and 12.3 (no purchase commitment; no exclusivity commitment). If Silverline needs some protection, we could consider exclusivity limited to a defined product category for 12 months that ends automatically if service levels or delivery dates are missed.
proposal.summary: Delete Section 2.2 exclusivity obligation binding Customer.
